source.description: A private library to collect, organize and play videos

goal.en: Build a private home for videos worth returning to: collect them, organize them into categories and tags, then browse and play them in one library. Snail is in development toward its first v0.1.0 release; the stack below is the source team’s confirmed implementation plan. This page publishes its Hexly brand identity independently of the product release.
goal.zh: 为值得回看的视频建立私人资料库：收藏、分类、打标签，再集中浏览与播放。Snail 正在开发首个 v0.1.0 版本，下方是源团队确认的实现技术栈。本页先独立发布 Hexly 品牌档案，产品发布由 Snail 团队完成。

alt.en: A faceted terracotta snail moving toward one red point on a quiet spiral paper field
alt.zh: 陶土色碎片蜗牛朝向一枚红点，衬以浅色螺旋纸纹

caption.en: Keep a moment. Find it again.

description.en: A collection kept close. A moment found again. A broad terracotta shell, connected ink-and-olive facets and one red point bring Snail into the Hexly animal family.
description.zh: 把收藏留在身边，让好片随时重逢。宽阔的陶土螺壳、连贯的墨绿碎片与一枚红点，让 Snail 成为 Hexly 动物家族的一员。

description.en: Preserve the full snail and its single forward red point. Keep the native animal colors; use the real Hexly palettes for text and surfaces. The point is not a health indicator.
description.zh: 保留完整蜗牛与前方唯一红点。动物沿用原生色彩，文字与界面使用真实 Hexly 色板；红点不代表运行状态。

description.en: Square Icon and wide Hero were generated independently. Keep their native proportions and at least 6.25% clear space. Use the separate square on mobile, without cropping the wide image.
description.zh: 方形 Icon 与宽幅 Hero 分别生成。保持原始比例与至少 6.25% 留白；手机使用独立方形版本，不裁剪横幅。

description.en: Mark 16px minimum; 24px preferred in navigation. Wordmark ≥72px, lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO for small marks; quiet, repeatable paper textures stay separate.
description.zh: 标志最小 16px，导航推荐 24px；字标宽度至少 72px，组合至少 160px。小标记使用透明 PNG/ICO，低对比可平铺纸纹独立使用。

subject.en: A complete faceted terracotta snail returning to one red point
subject.zh: 朝向一枚红点的完整陶土色碎片蜗牛

description.en: A low complete snail moves toward a single red point. Its broad shell and steady silhouette retain native rounded-outline clearance of 145.5px at 2048px, without resizing, moving or cropping the animal.
description.zh: 低伏的完整蜗牛朝向一枚红点。宽壳与稳定轮廓在原生 2048px 画布上距实际圆角边界至少 145.5px，没有缩放、移动或裁切主体。

description.en: Terracotta shell planes spiral inward while ink-and-olive fragments follow the body. Azure OpenAI GPT Image 2 generated the artwork; all 1,227,417 opaque pixels remain identical after transparent extraction. This is raster artwork, not a native SVG.
description.zh: 陶土壳面向内回旋，墨绿碎片顺着身体连接。主视觉由 Azure OpenAI GPT Image 2 生成，透明提取后 1,227,417 个不透明像素保持原样；这是位图作品，不是原生 SVG。

description.en: A polygon spiral and returning trail live on separate paper layers. Light and dark 512px seamless textures use Hexly tokens at 3.8% ink and 3.2% accent opacity. The wide Hero is a separate native 2560×1024 generation.
description.zh: 多边形螺旋与回返轨迹置于独立纸纹层。明暗两款 512px 无缝底纹沿用 Hexly 色板，墨色透明度 3.8%、重点色 3.2%；宽幅 Hero 为独立原生 2560×1024 生成。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64px the spiral, head and red point remain distinct. At 32/24/16px the broad shell and low silhouette carry recognition; small facets, antennae and the point soften. Navigation and browser tabs use the complete transparent foreground, without an extra mask.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64px 可辨认螺旋、头部与红点；32/24/16px 主要依靠宽壳和低伏轮廓识别，小切面、触角与红点会柔化。导航和页签使用完整透明前景，不另加遮罩。
